units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Determine the common difference from two terms, then reuse it in a finite arithmetic-series sum.
units.difficulty_basis: Determine the common difference from two terms, then reuse it in a finite arithmetic-series sum.
units.summary: Find an arithmetic difference and a long partial sum.

units.year_basis: AS/Year12 demand: Use the quadratic maximum; no composite or inverse function operation is needed.
units.difficulty_basis: Use the quadratic maximum; no composite or inverse function operation is needed.
units.summary: Find the range of a downward quadratic.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Apply two explicitly supplied functions in their stated order.
units.difficulty_basis: Apply two explicitly supplied functions in their stated order.
units.summary: Evaluate a composite function numerically.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Rearrange the supplied rational expression for its input.
units.difficulty_basis: Rearrange the supplied rational expression for its input.
units.summary: Find an inverse rational function.

exceptions: Source rational function and quadratic range visually verified.

units.year_basis: AS/Year12 demand: Combine logarithms, exponentiate and check positive arguments.
units.difficulty_basis: Combine logarithms, exponentiate and check positive arguments.
units.summary: Solve a difference-of-logarithms equation.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Substitute standard small-angle approximations at the stated arguments and collect powers.
units.difficulty_basis: Substitute standard small-angle approximations at the stated arguments and collect powers.
units.summary: Expand a small-angle expression to quadratic order.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Find two derivatives and inspect the change of gradient/concavity around the stated stationary point. The point-of-inflection assessment is additional A-level demand.
units.difficulty_basis: Find two derivatives and inspect the change of gradient/concavity around the stated stationary point. The point-of-inflection assessment is additional A-level demand.
units.summary: Classify a stationary point of inflection on a quartic.

exceptions: Joint3mark tariff(a) includes first/second derivatives; joint4mark tariff(b) includes verification and point-of-inflection proof.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Determine the missing radian angle and reuse it to combine sector areas and boundary arc lengths.
units.difficulty_basis: Determine the missing radian angle and reuse it to combine sector areas and boundary arc lengths.
units.summary: Find angles, area and perimeter of a composite sector logo.

exceptions: Composite sector figure and stated congruence visually checked.

units.year_basis: AS/Year12 demand: Differentiate a cubic, construct its tangent, verify the second intersection and reuse these boundaries in exact polynomial integration.
units.difficulty_basis: Differentiate a cubic, construct its tangent, verify the second intersection and reuse these boundaries in exact polynomial integration.
units.summary: Find a tangent and the polynomial area between it and a curve.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Find the unprinted derivative coefficients, use the point and normal gradient, then solve the resulting simultaneous parameter equations.
units.difficulty_basis: Find the unprinted derivative coefficients, use the point and normal gradient, then solve the resulting simultaneous parameter equations.
units.summary: Determine parameters of an implicit curve from its normal.

exceptions: Implicit derivative numerator/denominator signs and parameter placeholders visually verified.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Recognise the alternating signs of cos(180n)degrees and apply a convergent geometric sum starting at the second term.
units.difficulty_basis: Recognise the alternating signs of cos(180n)degrees and apply a convergent geometric sum starting at the second term.
units.summary: Sum an infinite alternating trigonometric-geometric series.

exceptions: Geometric ratio is3/4 to power n multiplied by cos(180n)degrees; initial n=2.

units.year_basis: AS/Year12 demand: Apply logarithm laws to the explicitly supplied pendulum formula.
units.difficulty_basis: Apply logarithm laws to the explicitly supplied pendulum formula.
units.summary: Linearise a power-law model with logarithms.

units.year_basis: AS/Year12 demand: Determine slope and intercept, invert the intercept logarithm and interpret the resulting constant at unit length.
units.difficulty_basis: Determine slope and intercept, invert the intercept logarithm and interpret the resulting constant at unit length.
units.summary: Fit and interpret a power-law model from a logarithmic graph.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Sketch reflected/translated branches, solve across branch domains and reuse the unprinted maximum point in a composite graph transformation.
units.difficulty_basis: Sketch reflected/translated branches, solve across branch domains and reuse the unprinted maximum point in a composite graph transformation.
units.summary: Transform a modulus graph and solve its parameterised inequality.

exceptions: Source transformation(c) is y=3-5f(x/2); grouped so derived maximum is not assumed.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Transform the radical and limits, simplify the rational integrand and reuse the new bounds to evaluate polynomial and logarithmic terms.
units.difficulty_basis: Transform the radical and limits, simplify the rational integrand and reuse the new bounds to evaluate polynomial and logarithmic terms.
units.summary: Evaluate a radical rational integral after a supplied substitution.

exceptions: Source substitution is u=1+sqrt(x), not u=1+x.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Use the chain rule in both parameters, form their derivative ratio and reuse it at an exact trigonometric input selected from the height condition.
units.difficulty_basis: Use the chain rule in both parameters, form their derivative ratio and reuse it at an exact trigonometric input selected from the height condition.
units.summary: Differentiate a reciprocal-trigonometric parametric curve.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Relate volume to depth and combine inflow with the height-dependent outflow.
units.difficulty_basis: Relate volume to depth and combine inflow with the height-dependent outflow.
units.summary: Construct a tank-depth differential equation from flow rates.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Separate the supplied rate equation, fit the initial condition and reuse the limiting depth to test the physical tank-height constraint.
units.difficulty_basis: Separate the supplied rate equation, fit the initial condition and reuse the limiting depth to test the physical tank-height constraint.
units.summary: Solve a tank-flow equation and assess whether it fills.

units.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 demand: Derive unprinted amplitude-phase constants, reuse them for the first maximum and solve radian boundary equations over one revolution.
units.difficulty_basis: Derive unprinted amplitude-phase constants, reuse them for the first maximum and solve radian boundary equations over one revolution.
units.summary: Model the maximum height and submerged duration of a water-wheel paddle.

units.year_basis: AS/Year12 demand: Recognise that the vertical baseline must vary with time; no radian trigonometric manipulation is required.
units.difficulty_basis: Recognise that the vertical baseline must vary with time; no radian trigonometric manipulation is required.
units.summary: Refine a height model for changing water level.

exceptions: Joint(b)(ii)3marks includes both maximum height and first maximum time.
